messages:
Clara (Marketing): kicking off a concise benchmark narrative for the launch: want a short webinar segment + 3 social posts that make the latency vs cost tradeoff crystal clear. aim = enable inbound demos that self-segment by SLA needs.
Omar (Growth): love it. KPI: demo signups and estimator usage. recommend 1 hero stat + interactive CTA.
Riley (Product): propose these visuals: 1) tradeoff curve (p95 latency on x, $/1k on y) across model variants; 2) stacked latency bands showing how batching/caching shifts the mass; 3) waterfall showing monthly cost delta at 10M tokens for different routing policies.
Kai (Design): Ill do two visual treatments: "engineering-first" (detailed axes, raw units) and "pm-friendly" (simplified, annotated takeaway). which should be primary?
Clara (Marketing): PM-friendly as primary for webinar audience, engineering-first as a downloadable one-pager for technical follow-ups.
Nina (ML): data notes for charting: use our latest perf run (region: eu-west1, prompt_len median 48). include configurations: quantization, KV cache, batch sizing. example chart spec:
```
series: [redwood-small-q, redwood-medium-q4, open-7b-8bit]
x: p95_latency_ms
y: cost_per_1k_tokens
filter: region=="eu-west1" and prompt_len<=64
agg: p95
```
This will show the knee where latency increases faster than cost savings.
Sam (Sales): include a short enterprise line: "SLA-backed Dedicated: sub-120ms P95 options for mission-critical flows". also add recommended routing text for sales decks.
Omar (Growth): for social CTAs: A) "Where does your app land on the latency-cost curve? Try our estimator." B) "Lower latency or lower cost? See the tradeoffs live." run A/B across devtool lists.
Riley (Product): for the routing playbook slide, suggested copy: "Fastpath: P95 < 120ms -> route to low-latency model; Balanced: 120-300ms -> hybrid; Costpath: >300ms -> cheap variant + aggressive caching. Fallbacks: region/variant failover.
Include a small table mapping common UX cases to recommended path (chat, search, batch-embeds).
Kai (Design): quick Q: hero stat suggestions? raw example: "Up to 3x lower P95 for real-time agents vs cost-optimized variants" or "Save up to 60% on token spend with caching+batching". Which resonates more?
Clara (Marketing): use both: hero stat for latency in webinar; hero stat for cost in follow-up email.
Nina (ML): attaching a short assumptions blurb to the chart: "assumptions: seq_len=64, batch_auto=true, kv_cache=enabled, quant=4bit for q4 models". will export CSV with p50/p95/p99 and a small summary.
announce-bot: Reminder: design mocks due in 36h for review.
Sam (Sales): also prepare a one-line trigger for lead routing: "SLA_need=low_latency -> Sales rep: Enterprise AE; SLA_need=balanced -> product demo; SLA_need=cost -> self-serve flow". We can capture via estimator opt-in.
Omar (Growth): I'll wire the estimator landing page and set up click-tracking for CTAs. will A/B headline and record conversion by segment.
Clara (Marketing): action list: Kai mockups (pm + eng), Nina CSV + assumptions, Riley routing slide copy + UX mapping, Omar CTA text + A/B plan, Sam enterprise trigger text. I'll draft the webinar blurb once visuals are in. Keeping this thread as canonical. Thanks team :sparkles:
